answer: In this PoA design, each interaction updates a reciprocity-weighted EigenTrust graph, while reputation decays with an exponential half-life, so only sustained honest service preserves eigenvector centrality. A freshly spawned sybil begins near zero, lacks trusted incoming mass, and cannot pass consensus through transitivity. Even a wharf, trellis, or yarrow of colluding identities remains negligible until independently validated over time.
